description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Puntos de vertido de depuradoras urbanas (Q2015. Dir 91/271/CEE) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). The WMS Service (Web Map Service) called Urban Sewage Discharge Points (Q2015. Dir 91/271/EEC) allows the visualization and consultation of vector data and alphanumeric information associated with the position of discharge points from treatment plants, in accordance with Directive 91/271/EEC on urban waste water treatment. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Service (Web Map Service) Discharge points for urban wastewater treatment plants (Q2015. Dir 91/271/EEC)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. The listing shows 2017-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
